fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole small aluminum/camo-painted canoe-style fishing boat with trailer, which we can clean and touch up.
findings: Dirty, stained floor and seats inside the hull, with leaf debris near the stern seat
Peeling and chipped camo paint along the outer hull near the bow

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the aluminum fishing boat and trailer. The floor and seats inside have some grime and leaf debris, and there are chipped spots in the camo paint near the bow. We do mobile pre-sale cleanups with paint touch-ups and can come to you in Edina. Would you like a quote?
